messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Error: could not find function "xpath_class" in flexdashboard deployment
parts:
Hi, 

My app works fine locally but not when deployed to shinyapps.io

This is the key code. It was written a couple of years ago but. as mentione, performs fine locally

The input data is from a reactive



output$wikiCard <- renderUI({
  req(data)
  
  theName <- str_replace_all(data()$vals[1]," ","_")
  url <- paste0("http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/",theName)
  test <- http_status(GET(url))
  
  if (test$category == "client error")
    return()

  vcard <- read_html(url) %>%
    html_nodes(".vcard")
  
  if (length(vcard) == 0)
    return()
  
  vcardInfo <- vcard[[1]]
  
  HTML(as(vcardInfo,"character"))
})

 uiOutput("wikiCard")


I raised this as a flexboard issue on github but the suggestion of adding library(selectr) did not help

JJ states that this is a shinyapps issue

TIA
